input.summary: Insert missing Vendor indemnity as new Section 20 and repair the broken cross-reference in 9.3
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnification section even though Sections 9.3, 21.3 and 30.5 assume one exists (9.3 cross-refers to Section 20.5). We have inserted our standard Vendor indemnity covering IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data incidents and wilful misconduct, with the usual notice/control procedure and IP remedies; per Section 21.3 indemnification obligations sit outside the liability cap.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

Customer shall defend and indemnify Vendor against third-party claims to the extent arising out of Customer-provided content or Customer's breach of Applicable Law. The indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice of a claim, the indemnifying Party shall control the defence with counsel of its choice, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense. No settlement that imposes a non-monetary obligation or admission on the indemnified Party may be made without its prior written consent.

If an infringement claim is made or reasonably anticipated, Vendor shall at its expense procure the necessary rights, or modify or replace the affected Services or Deliverables with a functionally equivalent, non-infringing alternative; if none is reasonably available, Customer may terminate the affected Order Form and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees and Fees paid for affected Deliverables.

input.summary: Delete the 24-month worldwide non-compete on Customer
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept any restriction on the products or services we may develop, buy or sell, so we have deleted this clause; it also directly contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no non-compete commitment.

input.summary: Delete the disclose-and-match precondition to engaging another provider
input.comment: [Playbook] We must remain free to buy from other suppliers, and conditioning that freedom on disclosing and matching offers is a de facto exclusivity/right of first refusal; we have deleted it, consistent with Section 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no exclusivity commitment.

input.summary: Delete the MFN running against Customer
input.comment: [Playbook] An MFN in our favour is welcome, but we do not accept an obligation to disclose and match third-party offers for Vendor's benefit; we have struck it and rely on Section 12.3's no-most-favoured-customer acknowledgement.
